visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor setting. A man with messy dark hair and glasses (HowHow) sits on a brown leather couch in a bright living room with white curtains. He wears a black t-shirt with a small red circular logo. He gestures with his hands while speaking, appearing frustrated. A white book or package rests on his lap. (2) Cut to a second man (Ah Ming) wearing a white hoodie and a black baseball cap, sitting on the same couch. He is holding a smartphone horizontally as if gaming. He coughs into his hand, and variety-show style text "Loser" appears near his head. (3) HowHow looks at his friend with an annoyed and confused expression. The lighting is bright and consistent. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom of the frame. (4) A rapid sequence shows HowHow packing a green suitcase, looking into a gold-framed mirror to adjust his hair, and walking through a doorway with a pull-up bar. Ah Ming is seen reading a book titled "Where's Wally?" while coughing excessively. (5) Transition to an outdoor park with green grass and large trees. HowHow is walking and then running toward the camera with an excited look. He encounters a man dressed as the legendary Shennong sitting under a tree eating leaves. (6) Shennong, wearing an ancient Chinese hat and robes with a fake mustache and long beard, speaks to HowHow. HowHow gestures animatedly as they talk. (7) Shennong presents a yellow packet and a blister pack of lozenges. Graphics of honey, herbs, and wood roots overlay the screen alongside promotional text highlighting product ingredients and the 25% propolis increase. (8) Back indoors on the couch, HowHow gives the lozenges to Ah Ming. Ah Ming takes one and shows a surprised, refreshed expression. HowHow looks at his phone, appearing shocked by the result. (9) Final shot of HowHow standing in front of a 7-Eleven store, holding the yellow product packet and smiling broadly at the camera. Large text overlays promote the product and its availability.

(6) A third male voice (Shennong) enters, characterized by a deep, raspy, and parodic quality. The background music shifts slightly to a more whimsical and comedic instrumentation. (8) Sound of a swallow or gulping effect. Ah Ming's voice suddenly sounds much clearer and brighter, while the comedic background music builds in intensity. (9) The music swells into a final energetic jingle. HowHow delivers a loud, enthusiastic call to action, and the audio ends with a clean cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction of conflict (annoying friend) -> Quest for solution -> Product intervention -> Result reveal -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic sketch advertisement for Lotte Propolis & Licorice Lozenges. It depicts the protagonist dealing with a 'toxic' friend who constantly coughs and insults him. The protagonist seeks out the legendary Shennong for a cure, leading to the product reveal. The intended appeal is to showcase the product's throat-soothing benefits in a humorous, high-energy format, directing viewers to purchase them at 7-Eleven.
